document_name: Speed WMS Inventory Data Model — Inventaires

core_tables.ART_PAR: Article master — article details for inventory lines

IVE_DAT.description: Inventory header — one record per inventory session
IVE_DAT.note: Inventory does NOT use ACT_CODE as primary access key — uses IVE_CODE + IVE_DATE instead

columns.name: IVE_CODE
columns.description: Inventory session code — part of composite business key

columns.name: IVE_DATE
columns.description: Inventory date — part of composite business key

columns.name: ACT_CODE
columns.description: Activity code — present but NOT the primary access key for inventory

IVL_DAT.description: Inventory lines — one record per location or article counted

columns.name: IVE_CODE
columns.description: Inventory session code — links to IVE_DAT

columns.name: IVL_NOOL
columns.description: Line number within the inventory session

inventory_header_to_lines.description: Get inventory session with all its counted lines
inventory_header_to_lines.example_sql: SELECT ive.IVE_CODE, ive.IVE_DATE, ivl.IVL_NOOL, ivl.ART_CODE, ivl.EMP_LIEU FROM IVE_DAT ive INNER JOIN IVL_DAT ivl ON ive.IVE_CODE = ivl.IVE_CODE AND ive.IVE_DATE = ivl.IVE_DATE WHERE ive.IVE_CODE = :IVE_CODE

inventory_lines_with_article_details.description: Get inventory lines with full article information
inventory_lines_with_article_details.example_sql: SELECT ive.IVE_CODE, ive.IVE_DATE, ivl.EMP_LIEU, ivl.ART_CODE, art.ART_DESL FROM IVE_DAT ive INNER JOIN IVL_DAT ivl ON ive.IVE_CODE = ivl.IVE_CODE AND ive.IVE_DATE = ivl.IVE_DATE INNER JOIN ART_PAR art ON ivl.ACT_CODE = art.ACT_CODE AND ivl.ART_CODE = art.ART_CODE WHERE ive.IVE_CODE = :IVE_CODE ORDER BY ivl.EMP_LIEU, ivl.ART_CODE

inventory_lines_with_location.description: Get inventory lines with location details
inventory_lines_with_location.example_sql: SELECT ive.IVE_CODE, ivl.EMP_LIEU, ivl.ART_CODE FROM IVE_DAT ive INNER JOIN IVL_DAT ivl ON ive.IVE_CODE = ivl.IVE_CODE AND ive.IVE_DATE = ivl.IVE_DATE INNER JOIN EMP_BAS emp ON ivl.EMP_LIEU = emp.EMP_LIEU WHERE ive.IVE_CODE = :IVE_CODE

query.sql: SELECT ive.IVE_CODE, ive.IVE_DATE, ivl.IVL_NOOL, ivl.ART_CODE, ivl.EMP_LIEU FROM IVE_DAT ive INNER JOIN IVL_DAT ivl ON ive.IVE_CODE = ivl.IVE_CODE AND ive.IVE_DATE = ivl.IVE_DATE WHERE ive.IVE_CODE = :IVE_CODE ORDER BY ivl.IVL_NOOL;

procedures.business_logic: Get all counted lines for a given inventory session.

query.sql: SELECT ive.IVE_CODE, ive.IVE_DATE, COUNT(ivl.IVL_NOOL) AS line_count FROM IVE_DAT ive LEFT JOIN IVL_DAT ivl ON ive.IVE_CODE = ivl.IVE_CODE AND ive.IVE_DATE = ivl.IVE_DATE WHERE ive.ACT_CODE = :ACT_CODE AND ive.IVE_DATE BETWEEN :DATE_FROM AND :DATE_TO GROUP BY ive.IVE_CODE, ive.IVE_DATE ORDER BY ive.IVE_DATE DESC;

procedures.business_logic: Get all inventory sessions within a date range with their line counts.

safety_rules: Inventory primary access key is IVE_CODE + IVE_DATE — NOT ACT_CODE alone
ACT_CODE is still present on inventory tables but is NOT the primary filter — always use IVE_CODE
IVL_DAT line key is IVE_CODE + IVE_DATE + IVL_NOOL
Always execute SELECT before UPDATE operations
Do not execute UPDATE or DELETE on inventory tables in production without approval
